channel.description: Latest articles from The Chatham Daily News (chathamdailynews.ca)

item.title: Driver airlifted after Walpole crash
item.description: A driver was airlifted to hospital with critical injuries after a Saturday morning crash on Walpole Island First Nation, police said.

item.title: Defence leads Ursuline Lancers past St. Pat's Fighting Irish for four-peat
item.description: The Ursuline Lancers’ quick hands made quick work of the St. Patrick’s Fighting Irish.

item.title: Chatham Maroons have clear path to first place
item.description: The Chatham Maroons’ fate is in their own hands.

item.title: David Brown leads Blenheim Blades to comeback win
item.description: David Brown’s hat trick led the Blenheim Blades past the Wheatley Sharks 6-3 in Game 1 of their PJHL Stobbs Division quarter-final Sunday.

item.title: Bail hearing booked for woman charged in multi-unit fire in Blenheim
item.description: Jocelyne Charuk, 42, of Blenheim, made a brief court appearance in a Chatham court on Monday by video.

item.title: Workforce Week aims to help prepare Chatham-Kent residents for job opportunities
item.description: Chatham-Kent is growing which is expected to create new job opportunities for residents.

item.title: Local roundup: Matteis, Branton win OUA gold; Bluebirds even series
item.description: Chatham’s Quinn Matteis and Port Lambton’s Shona Branton were big winners at the OUA swimming championships.

item.title: Man who supplied gun testifies at Walpole Island murder trial
item.description: The man who supplied the gun testified Monday as a Walpole Island first-degree murder trial continued at the Sarnia courthouse.
